workflow.critical: All test case content must be verified against {reporting_language}
Execute ALL steps in exact order

step.goal: Resolve suite name from argument or active suite in test-suites.yml

check.if: no suite name argument is provided
file does not exist or active_suite is empty
check.output: ❌ No active suite found. Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite <name> first.

step.action: Find the suite entry where name = {suite_name}

check.output: ⚠️ Suite status is "{current_status}" — test cases may not have been generated yet. Continuing validation anyway; artifact checks will catch missing files.

step.goal: Load test case artifacts and compute expected AC count
step.action: Read ALL story files in {story_files}; count {expected_ac_count} = total unique ACs
Record the expected artifact paths: - XLSX: {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/{story_id}-test-cases.xlsx - MD: {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/{story_id}-test-cases.md
If the MD file exists: read it to count test cases by type and collect test case IDs

step.goal: Run all quality checks and collect issues
step.check: Both XLSX and MD files exist at the correct paths inside {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/
Every AC from ALL provided stories has at least one positive test case — total positive tests ≥ {expected_ac_count}. List any AC that has zero coverage.
Every AC has at least one negative test case covering invalid or rejected input
Each test case has ALL required fields populated: ID, title, description, preconditions, numbered steps, test data, expected result — no field is blank
No duplicate test case IDs exist in the test suite
Edge case test cases are present: boundary values, empty inputs, max-length, special characters
Security and permission test cases are present when the story involves authentication or roles (SQL injection, XSS, unauthenticated access, RBAC)
Steps use actual field names, URLs, and values from the story — no placeholders like "[field]", "[value]", or "TBD"
Expected results are specific and measurable — NOT vague phrases like "يعمل بشكل صحيح", "the system works", or "success"
All text content is in {reporting_language} — no content in another language
Test types cover all applicable categories: وظيفي، تحقق، حد، أمان، صلاحيات

step.goal: Present validation report and ask how to proceed

check.output:
✅ Validation Passed — /aiqa-generatetestcases
All 11 quality checks passed. Test case files are complete and accurate. Suite: {suite_name} | ACs covered: {expected_ac_count} No issues found — safe to proceed to /aiqa-generatee2e.

step.output:
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ 🔍 Validation Report — /aiqa-generatetestcases ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
Suite : {suite_name} Output : {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/ ACs expected: {expected_ac_count}
🔴 Critical ({critical_count}): (for each Critical issue: " • {id} — {description}" + detail) (if none: " None")
🟠 High ({high_count}): (for each High issue: " • {id} — {description}" + detail) (if none: " None")
🟡 Medium ({medium_count}): (for each Medium issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
🔵 Low ({low_count}): (for each Low issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
Total issues: {total_issues}
step.ask: How would you like to proceed? A) Fix ALL {total_issues} issue(s) — resolve every finding B) Fix only Critical + High ({critical_count + high_count} issue(s)) — skip Medium and Low C) Skip — keep the report, apply no fixes

step.goal: Apply fixes to test case files
step.action: Determine issues to fix: Choice A → fix ALL issues Choice B → fix only Critical and High issues

For each issue selected for fixing: TC-1 → re-run /aiqa-generatetestcases {suite_name} to regenerate missing files TC-2 → for each AC with zero test coverage: generate at least one positive test case covering the happy-path scenario TC-3 → for each AC lacking a negative test: add a test case with invalid/rejected input and the expected error response TC-4 → add at least 3 edge case tests: empty input, maximum-length value, special characters (؟!@#) TC-5 → if story involves auth or roles: add SQL injection, XSS payload, unauthenticated access, and RBAC denial test cases TC-6 → for each test case with blank fields: fill every empty field (ID, title, steps, expected result) with accurate, story-specific content TC-7 → find all "[field]", "[value]", "TBD" placeholders; replace with exact values from the story (field names, URLs, sample data) TC-8 → identify vague expected results; rewrite each to state the specific outcome, UI change, or API response expected TC-9 → find duplicate IDs; renumber sequentially (TC-0001, TC-0002, …) TC-10 → translate any non-{reporting_language} content to {reporting_language} TC-11 → add test cases for any missing applicable category (boundary, security, permissions) Save the corrected MD file and regenerate XLSX from the corrected content.
step.output: ✍️ Fixes applied — test case files updated.

step.goal: Re-verify fixed checks and report final status
step.action: Re-read the MD test case file
Re-run ONLY the checks that were targeted for fixing
step.output:
📋 Validation Summary — /aiqa-generatetestcases
(for each fixed check:) ✅ {id} — resolved: {what was corrected} (for each still failing:) ❌ {id} — still failing: {reason} (for each skipped check:) ⏭️ {id} — skipped (outside selected fix scope)
(if all targeted checks pass:) ✅ All targeted issues resolved. Safe to proceed to /aiqa-generatee2e.
(if some still fail:) ⚠️ {remaining} issue(s) could not be fixed automatically. Edit the test case files manually, then re-run /aiqa-generatetestcases-validate.
